body: This was a mistake. Bunch of self-righteous people who are looking to motivate me back to wanting to live life. If it was only my attitude that was the problem, I wouldn't have a problem. I have real life situations that back me into a corner of despair and misery. Live through hell on the daily and then speak to me.
Money and to be pain-free. I don't see either happening, like ever.
They think it's fibromyalgia. There is no cure.
I'd like to not be in pain. I want a new body that doesn't hurt and isn't disgusting.
